more.def: Strong and hard to break, tear or cut.
examples: The tough rope held the boat in the storm.
This meat is too tough to chew.
Her backpack is made of tough cloth.

easy.def: Hard to do.
examples: It was a tough test.
The tough puzzle took an hour.
A tough job.

more.def: Difficult to do or deal with.
examples: The math test was tough, but I finished.
It was a tough climb to the top of the hill.
She made a tough decision.

easy.def: To make stronger.
examples: Hard work will toughen you.
Exercise toughens muscles.
Rain toughened the plants.

more.def: To make or become tougher and stronger.
examples: Exercise will toughen your muscles.
The rough work toughened his hands.
Cold weather toughened the plants.

easy.def: A small wig for a bald spot.
examples: He wore a toupee.
The toupee blew off.
The toupee was brown.

more.def: A small wig worn to cover a bald spot on the head.
examples: The wind blew the man's toupee off his head.
The actor wore a toupee for the part.
His toupee did not match his gray hair.

easy.def: A trip to see places.
examples: We took a tour.
The tour of the museum was fun.
A tour of the farm.

more.def: A trip in which you visit places and learn about them.
examples: We took a tour of the museum.
The guide led a tour of the old castle.
The band went on tour.

easy.def: To visit places and look around.
examples: We toured the castle.
She tours the zoo.
They toured the city.

more.def: To visit and look around a place.
examples: We toured the castle with a guide.
The class toured the fire station.
They toured the city by bus.

easy.def: Visiting places for fun.
examples: Tourism helps the town.
The town lives on tourism.
Tourism is growing.

more.def: The business of travel and visiting places for fun.
examples: Tourism helps the small seaside town.
The island depends on tourism.
Tourism brings visitors to the park each summer.

easy.def: A person who travels to see new places.
examples: The tourist took photos.
Many tourists visit the beach.
The tourist had a map.

more.def: A person who travels to a place for fun and to see sights.
examples: The tourist took pictures of the tower.
Many tourists visit the beach in summer.
The tourists followed the guide through the museum.

easy.def: A set of games to find the best team.
examples: We played in a soccer tournament.
The tournament is on Saturday.
The tournament was exciting.

more.def: A competition in which many players or teams play games until one wins.
examples: The tennis tournament drew players from ten countries.
The chess tournament lasted two days.
Our team reached the final of the tournament.

easy.def: To mess up someone's hair.
examples: Dad tousled my hair.
The wind tousled her hair.
He tousled the dog's fur.

more.def: To make hair messy, often in a playful way.
examples: Dad tousled my hair and laughed.
The wind tousled her curls.
He tousled the puppy's fur.

easy.def: To pull something behind a vehicle.
examples: The truck tows the car.
They towed the boat.
We towed the trailer.

more.def: To pull something along behind a car, truck or boat.
examples: The truck towed our broken car to the garage.
The tug towed the barge.
Dad towed the boat on a trailer.

easy.def: In the direction of something.
examples: The dog ran toward me.
She walked toward the door.
The bird flew toward the sky.

more.def: Moving in the direction of someone or something.
examples: The ship sailed toward the shore.
A turtle crawled slowly toward the pond.
The plants lean toward the window.

easy.def: In the direction of something.
examples: The dog ran towards me.
We walked towards the park.
She turned towards the sound.

more.def: Moving in the direction of someone or something.
examples: The ship sailed towards the harbor.
A kitten crept towards the ball of yarn.
The flowers lean towards the sun.

easy.def: Something soft that you dry yourself with.
examples: I dry off with a towel.
Hang up the towel.
She grabbed a towel.

more.def: A soft piece of cloth used to dry your body or dishes.
examples: I wrapped a towel around me after I swam.
Dad hung the wet towel on the hook.
She dried the dishes with a clean towel.

easy.def: A very tall, narrow building or part of a building.
examples: We climbed up the tower.
The castle has a tall tower.
A bird sat on the clock tower.

more.def: A tall, narrow structure, either standing alone or rising from a larger building.
examples: From the top of the lighthouse tower, we could see the whole harbor.
A water tower stands high above the little town.
The church tower had a bell that rang every hour.

easy.def: Very tall.
examples: A towering tree.
The towering building is high.
The towering mountain loomed.

more.def: Very tall and high above what is around.
examples: A towering oak stood in the field.
We stared up at the towering skyscraper.
The towering waves crashed on the rocks.

easy.def: A place where many people live, smaller than a city.
examples: I live in a small town.
We went to town.
The town has a park.

more.def: A place where people live and work, bigger than a village and smaller than a city.
examples: Our town has a library, a bakery, and a park.
The whole town came to watch the parade.
We drove into town to buy groceries.

easy.def: The people who live in a town.
examples: The townsfolk came to the fair.
The townsfolk cheered.
All the townsfolk met.

more.def: The people who live in a particular town.
examples: The townsfolk gathered in the square to hear the news.
The friendly townsfolk waved as we drove through.
The townsfolk worked together to rebuild the bridge.

easy.def: A small area of land with local government.
examples: The township is small.
We live in a township.
The township has a school.

more.def: A small area of land with its own local government, or a small town.
examples: Our township has its own school and library.
The township holds a meeting each month.
Farms stretched across the township.

easy.def: The people who live in a town.
examples: The townspeople met.
The townspeople are kind.
We saw the townspeople at the fair.

more.def: The people who live in a town.
examples: The townspeople gathered in the square.
All the townspeople came to the fair.
In the story, the townspeople helped the baker.

easy.def: A poison made by a living thing.
examples: A snake makes a toxin.
The toxin is poison.
A toxin can harm you.

more.def: A poison that is made by a living thing, such as a plant, an animal or a germ.
examples: The frog's skin makes a toxin that protects it from enemies.
Some mushrooms have a toxin that can make you very sick.
A toxin is a poison made by a living thing.

easy.def: Something you play with.
examples: My toy is fun.
I have a toy car.
The toy is on the floor.

more.def: An object that children play with.
examples: My favorite toy is a stuffed bear.
The toy train rolled around the track.
She put her toys away.

easy.def: A person who makes toys.
examples: The toymaker made a doll.
A toymaker works in a shop.
The toymaker is old.

more.def: A person whose job is to make toys.
examples: The toymaker carved a wooden horse.
In the story, the toymaker built a little train.
A toymaker painted the doll's face.
